description.narrative: The Samsung Solve for Tomorrow (SFT) competition is a groundbreaking initiative designed to catalyse innovation within education. Developed in partnership with Samsung NZ, the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) Accelerator Lab as the implementer, and the Ministry of Education as the beneficiary, this competition serves as a beacon for empowering students. By integrating science, technology, engineering, arts, and mathematics (STEAM), SFT provides a platform for students to tackle real-world challenges head-on. Through this collaborative effort, the aim is to cultivate a new generation of thinkers and problem-solvers who will drive positive change in their communities and beyond. This engagement facility project aims to pilot the SFT initiative for Secondary School students in partnership with Samsung NZ and the Ministry of Education focusing on 1) find solutions to local community problems using Samsung know-how and technology, 2) support digitalization and tech in the Islands and nurture youths to become future leaders in the subjects of STEAM.
